get.description: All Work Breakdown Structure task codes for a given project, sorted by flat code. NOTE, this endpoint is currently in the experimental stage and is subject to change.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type of task codes to return

enum: all (returns both labor and equipment task codes in a single request)

parameters.name: serializer_view
parameters.description: Selects the response blueprint. Defaults to `task_code_entity` (full detail); `id_only` returns only identifiers. Takes precedence over the `view` parameter.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Selects the response blueprint. Defaults to `task_code_entity` (full detail); `id_only` returns only identifiers. Ignored when `serializer_view` is also provided.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/task_codes?type=SOME_STRING_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&serializer_view=SOME_STRING_VALUE&view=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters=SOME_OBJECT_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
